count_reason: Dubai is harsh with several distinct failure modes, so seven groups get 6 to 9 worlds each, 52 in total, kept under the 60 cap with more worlds for wide wind ranges.

groups.name: High steady wind
groups.reason: Dubai towers see strong sustained wind at height pushing the robot and tether; wind into the wall tested.

groups.name: Strong repeated gusts
groups.reason: Changes gust_count, gust_duration_s, gust_period_s, gust_speed_ms, gust_start_s, wind_dir_deg only. Sand and dust not tested.

groups.name: Dust on glass and seal
groups.reason: Desert dust lowers friction and seal quality. Sandstorm: dust load tested; dust on sensors and impeller not tested.

groups.name: Extreme heat and weak suction
groups.reason: Hot facades degrade battery and pad hold; low suction and high leak with low pad force stress grip.

groups.name: Wet humid glass
groups.reason: Morning humidity and condensation or cleaning water reduce friction; rain itself not tested.

groups.name: Tall mullions and joint gaps
groups.reason: Curtain wall joints can break the seal or snag the robot.

groups.name: Ledge and tight edges
groups.reason: Setbacks or ledges and small margins near the area limit can block or trap the robot.

not_tested.reason: No rain physics; only glass wetness is tested.
No physics; heat is tested only as air and battery temperature.
Coastal salt spray and corrosion are not modelled.

not_tested.factor: Building height and wind by height
not_tested.reason: No wind profile; only drop below roof and wind speed are varied by hand.
Not modelled and rare in Dubai.

not_tested.factor: Sensor and impeller clogging by sand
not_tested.reason: Fields only cover dust on glass and seal leak.
The physics is hand-built and no real robot has checked it.
